title: OpenAI releases a new image classifier and ChatGPT warnings to combat CSAM
slides: Will OpenAI’s new image classifier make ChatGPT safer?
The tool flags and reports child sexual abuse material to authorities.
But the classifier may miss subtle cases and trigger false alarms.
Parents and moderators now get real-time warnings on suspicious content.
Test the classifier yourself—ask ChatGPT to flag an image.
thread_text:
1. Your kids' photos at risk?

OpenAI's new image classifier now flags and reports child sexual abuse material directly to authorities. It's a major shift in how AI platforms handle illegal content.

2. False alarms possible

The classifier may miss subtle cases and trigger false alarms, meaning innocent images could be flagged. This raises concerns about accuracy and trust.

3. Parents get real-time alerts

Parents and moderators now receive real-time warnings on suspicious content, allowing faster intervention. But how reliable are these warnings?

4. Test it yourself

You can ask ChatGPT to flag an image and see how the classifier works. It's a hands-on way to understand its strengths and weaknesses.

5. Would you trust it?

Try the classifier on a real image today. Does it catch what it should, or does it miss the mark? Your experience matters.
